name: 2026-08-15 — The Bodie Convergence
inGameDate: Late winter 2026-2027 (a Thursday; ~5 months after Ep 2)
summary: Four of the five converged on Bodie State Historic Park, each drawn by a separate pretext sent by Dakota, who did not come himself. A storm closed the road out and trapped them overnight. In the visitor center Mira noticed that the printed trail map had been edited down from a more detailed copper-print original on the wall — and, concentrating on what was missing, began perceiving faint outlines of things that had been erased. She used it repeatedly through the session, eventually locating a spot outside the visitor center where a building should have been. They found an 1878 mining-crew ledger carrying four of their surnames, with a fifth entry water-damaged past reading. A wartime federal annex on the site had a plaque nobody wanted to discuss. Priya lit a fire she could not afterwards explain, in front of everyone. On the way out, Morgan noticed the park's feedback QR codes were individually personalized. Dakota's voicemail reached them late: he had been in Sacramento, there were eight ledgers, and he had known more than he said. The party drove home angry with him.
notes: Retrospective log, reconstructed 2026-08-27 from episodes/003-bodie-convergence/dm/what-the-dm-holds.md §Played-session record. Dakota's player was absent; his convergence work was run off-screen and delivered by voicemail at session close.
